 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and grid[r][0]!=bg]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=bg]
    rb=[-1]+hr+[h]; cb=[-1]+vc+[w]
    regions=[]
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
      for j in range(len(cb)-1):
        r0,r1=rb[i]+1,rb[i+1]; c0,c1=cb[j]+1,cb[j+1]
        score=sum(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
        regions.append((score,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=max(regions)
    sh,sw=sr1-sr0,sc1-sc0
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for _,r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
      for r in range(r0,r1):
        for c in range(c0,c1):
          out[r][c]=grid[sr0+(r-r0)%sh][sc0+(c-c0)%sw]
    return out
